wi_press_it_out.blurb: Press It Out is a bouldering spot in Governor Dodge State Park, set apart from the main Plan B cluster and reached by a user trail along the rim. Ten problems on clean sandstone run from VB up to V5, with the bulk in the easy-to-moderate range: a few V0 to V1 warm-ups, a couple of V3s and one V4 and V5 for stronger climbers. The problems sit on a rim of rock a bit taller than the short boulders beside the trail.

wi_cube_the.blurb: The Cube is a big freestanding boulder in the Black River Falls bouldering area of central Wisconsin, resting just under the trail below the overlook. Ten problems climb its faces on sandstone, from V0 up to a V6, with the largest group at V4. Easier lines such as a V0 corner, a V1 and a V2 make it workable as a warm-up, while a handful of V4 variations and a traverse give harder climbers plenty to do. It sits across the trail from another named boulder, so it is simple to combine with its neighbours.

wi_pool_the.blurb: The Pool is a cluster of boulders in the talus of Devil's Lake's West Bluff, close to a distinctive flat rock shaped like a diving board. Ten problems here span V1 to V8: a few easy to moderate lines, a core of V4s, and several harder problems in the V5 to V8 range. The setting is boulder-hopping terrain downhill and across the talus from neighbouring boulders, so expect an uneven walk in and rough landings that reward a few pads and a spotter.

wi_block_party.blurb: Block Party is one large block sitting amid the open boulder field of the South Shore Talus at Devil's Lake, visible from the trail as you climb up beneath a rock pedestal. Its ten problems are a study in contrasts: a handful of easy V0 to V1 lines and a few V3 to V6 problems share the block with three problems at V10. Bouldering only.

wi_10_hidden_amphitheater.blurb: Hidden Amphitheater is a bouldering area on the East Bluff of Devil's Lake, in cliff bands and blocks above the big Railroad Amphitheater wall. Getting up takes a talus climb and a fourth-class scramble. The ten problems range from V0 to V9: several easy lines, a trio of V3s, and a couple of much harder problems at V6 and V9. Expect a bit of an adventure to get there.

wi_1_the_chamber_of_solitude.blurb: The Chamber of Solitude is a bouldering spot at High Cliff State Park on the Niagara Escarpment, tucked into a narrow cleft a short walk off a forest trail. Ten problems run from V0 to V5, centred on V2 and V3: several beginner-friendly lines, a pair of V3s, and a few harder problems at the top end. It is boulder-only climbing inside the cleft.

wi_warbler.blurb: Warbler is a group of mid-sized boulders on the north side of Devil's Lake's West Bluff, up the hill above the Holt memorial bench in the Massive Vertigo area. The ten problems are all bouldering and cover V2 to V8, with a cluster at V4 and a few harder problems from V6 up. This part of the lake is talus and trees, so the going is rugged and the landings uneven. The harder problems suit climbers at V4 and above.

wi_4_the_bulge.blurb: The Bulge is a roof-and-wall area on the north side of High Cliff State Park, just beyond the Red Bird statue climbs on the Niagara Escarpment. Of its ten climbs, seven are boulder problems from V1 to V8, two are top-ropes at the 5.12 level, and one is a moderate trad line around 5.9. The central bulge looks steep, with easier climbing on either side, and the starts are bouldery and tend to be pumpy.
